notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

This is a small update, with a few quality of life changes. We have turned some images into animations and we have fixed some of the issues with the phone and computer screens. We hope you enjoy these updates. 

Happy Gaming!

P.S. Steam is working on the review for Island of Corruption and we are hoping that review will be finished soon. Once it is approved, it will be released on Steam, and free to anyone who owns this game at that time.

notes.title: Update 14: Unreal Engine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/999722af8b1bb02455119b587b5d0c42c9bd4b14.png[/img]

Hello!

Apologies for the long hiatus, but we have been beating our heads against the wall of Ren'Py for a long time, and have finally surrendered, lol. It has served us very well, but it has now reached its limitations, and we must, perforce, evolve.

It is time, to put our dear friend, to bed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/7a27a69c5e430837d7b8447ff4829bb48e880fc6.png[/img]

And welcome her big sister, Unreal Engine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/665324ea206a4d647cb70ed74fd0ffb4002bd7c7.png[/img]

To give more detail, we have been running into issues with the detailed mapping, and video performance on Ren'Py since the beginning, and we believe that the program built into Unreal Engine, Blueprint, will allow us much greater versatility.

For those of you who have already purchased our game in its current state, there will be no additional price increase. When we release the new version, it should simply erase, and replace, the old.

Thank you for your patience during this transition.

notes.title: Update #13
notes.content:
Greetings! And Merry Christmas!

This update completes 1 path and increases the number of animations.

We are adding approximately 400 images.
We are also adding an additional 15 animations.
This is also the update where we add in the optional female MC for a future DLC, she is a character you will encounter on every story path, but who only becomes a possible MC on the heavy corruption path.

Fair warning, the story path that has been completed here, is the heavy corruption path. Some may find it disturbing, so play this path at your own risk.

FUTURE UPDATES:

There is one remaining story path to complete, which will branch into investigative, light corruption, and college harem. Hopefully, barring any additional story elements (This does tend to happen... but hey, additional content, am I right?), this will be done fairly quickly.

We will also be redoing a few of our earlier images and animations, as well as adding several additional animations.

Hello all!

Today's update adds:

Additional sound effect for the new content.

We are also working on the animations for this build, but bear in mind, with the way we are currently doing animations for this project, 60 fps, it does take a while.

notes.title: Partial Major Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

As promised, if slightly delayed, here is the major update we have been talking about.

We are mid building this update, so the majority of the new animations haven't been loaded in, nor the sound effects, and we haven't completed aftereffects or image editing.

But the images are in, and the story is in, and over the next couple of weeks, we will be updating the game every few days, adding in additional effects and updates.

Also, this version introduces you to a female character that has the potential to become a protagonist in one of the following DLC's! Once we have completed the base game, of course.

If you wish to wait before playing this storyline until the repairs and updates are complete, it would not be a bad idea. However, we wanted to put something out because it had been so long, and to reassure you that we were still working on the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/5376f54836cc1a7faa185d7f292455228f123e2c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: #8 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this update we are bringing you a gallery, and a map, which though functional, is presently stashed away in the gallery, since the narrative path is the only path at present, and the map is not useful for that.

Our internally scheduled next update should not only bring the map to life, with a number of additional storylines, but an in-game cell phone, new love interests, and navigable buildings. As well as the potential for a little magic...

With that, as always!
Happy Gaming!

notes.title: #7 Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

Thanks to all of you, this was an amazing launch of a first title, thank you all very much for your faith in our game, and we will strive to be worthy of your trust.

Originally, our intention had been to work exclusively on repairing the animations and updating the initial narrative. But then we realized how foolish that would be of us, lol. It would trap us in a permanent holding pattern, with no growth, only continuous development of a single narrative.

So instead, we will be adding additional content to the game, until we have the entire storyline out, and will work at the same time, on the animation repairs our main storyline needs. Which will hopefully result in a great and growing experience for all of you.

Now, of the paths we are planning, we are working on the paths that split off from the main narrative at the baseball game, at the very start of the game, when the MC has to decide, "Do I go with Michelle, or stay at the field?"

We are also providing a sneak peek of him at home, and his landlady modeling a new bikini in front of him and his roommates, before going for a nighttime dip in their pool:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/70a8be0af12eb4d0ccb5ddc4b37029baced3b752.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: So instead, we will be adding additional content to the game, until we have the entire storyline out, and will work at the same time, on the animation repairs our main storyline needs.

notes.title: #4 Website Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

This week, we have set up the official FPCGameSoftware website, and acquired a second beast of a machine for rendering animations. This should enhance our game by a great degree and increase the speed at which updates come out. We have also done a few promotional renders to whet the appetite of our fans.

In Game news, we have made some progress on that as well, adding a number of new NPC's and potential love interests for our hero, and some off campus housing with his landlady and roommates, who also may be potential love interests at some future date.

We have also added a coffee shop, which you can see in the render included, with a fan of FPCGameSoftware visiting our website.

So, if you'd like to see some renders, and or get some information about the team, and our goals, feel free to head on over to https://fpcgamesoftware.com/ and enjoy!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/e15b6ca1d50acf20357bcedeff2ef3c93b656cf5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: #2 Christmas Progress Update
notes.content:
We are still hard at work over here at FPCGameSoftware, and this week, we have four additional love interests to introduce you to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/e1bc40eeeb07b0be33f66b465f17102511270a21.jpg[/img]


Starting from the left, we have Whitney, Carmen, Grace, and Allison, though if you address her as anything but Ali, you'd better be a judge.

Whitney - A fellow college student, and party girl.
Carmen - A single mother, employed at a dead-end job, looking to find her next Papi.
Grace - An innocent college freshman trying to make friends.
Allison - A high school dropout, and skater chick, who parties hard, and crashes out harder.

These four LI's are on the secondary, and harem, story path, though they may have cameos on other paths.

This week we have been working primarily on the main path, animations, and combat mechanics and scenes.

See you next week!
